inferred_codex_to_gemini_chain: Hermes executes/merges and writes Codex-readable reentry.
Codex reads reentry and decides whether layer/space ambiguity requires Gemini.
If required, Codex authors a Gemini request packet with input_files, output_dir, desired lite fields, forbidden scope, and promotion=no.

A Codex-side Gemini bridge/runner consumes the request. For local tests use gemini_lens_runner_sim.py; for real model review use a bounded provider-backed Gemini CLI bridge only after explicit approval.
Gemini output is split into raw + lite + receipt.
Codex reads lite first, raw only if needed, and returns a maturation judgment to Hermes.
Hermes merges Codex judgment as evidence/HOLD unless user separately approves apply.

recommended_use.how_to_reduce_timeout: Keep first-pass refs compact; Codex decides Gemini necessity; use lite output; avoid repeated provider-backed calls.
recommended_use.now: Do not run Codex/Gemini. Preserve this as HOLD structure and use local simulated runner shape only if testing is needed.
recommended_use.when_codex_needs_gemini: Use codex_authored_gemini_request.json shape + gemini_lens_runner_sim.py for dry-run; replace runner with real Gemini bridge only with explicit user approval.
